field_verifications.proposed_value: immune cell subset frequencies and intracellular protein staining in peripheral blood mononuclear cells
field_verifications.evidence_text: For all phenotype panels, one million cells were surface-stained with the antibody cocktails shown in Table 1 . For staining of intracellular proteins, cells were fixed and permeabilized with Fix/Perm (eBioscience, USA) for 30 min at 4°C in the dark. Following culture, samples were processed according to standard protocols and stained intracellularly with Alexa Fluor 700-conjugated anti-IFN-γ and FITC-conjugated anti-TNF-α antibodies. Cells were permeabilized and stained intracellularly using PE-conjugated anti-IL2, Alexa Fluor 700-conjugated anti-IFNγ, and APC-conjugated anti-TNFα antibodies. We next stained PBMCs obtained prevaccination and at Day 7, Day 14, Day 28, and Day 86 postvaccination with 5 antibody panels aimed at detecting the following: monocytes and dendritic cell (DC) phenotype, natural killer (NK) phenotype, B cell phenotype, NK function and T cell function
field_verifications.reason: The text supports measurement of immune cell phenotypes/frequencies and intracellular cytokine/protein staining in PBMCs.

field_verifications.evidence_text: To obtain biotin-labeled cRNA, total RNA was amplified, labeled, and purified using the GeneChip 3’IVT Express Kit (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, CA, USA) following the manufacturer’s instructions.
